section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study 1) examining the indirect effects of family fat talk on mindful eating through body appreciation and functional body appreciation among 333 undergraduate female participants at a southeastern U.S. university. Participants completed online surveys measuring mindful eating, family fat talk, body appreciation, and functional body appreciation, with results indicating that family fat talk was inversely associated with mindful eating and both body image indices.
